extDescription.message: Hide Twitch channels, categories and keywords without unfollowing. Snooze streamers for a while or until you unhide them.

menuSnoozeIntro.message: Hidden from your sidebar, Browse and search. You still follow them.

menuAlwaysShownIntro.message: Always shown. Your hiding rules for them are paused.

categoryHideIntro.message: Hides this category, its streams and its sidebar rows. You can still let favourite streamers through.

toastCategoryHidden.message: {category} hidden. Let streamers through in Hidden content.

toastPeekOn.message: Peek is on: hidden items are shown faded.

managerSubtitle.message: What you’ve hidden on Twitch, and when it comes back

managerButtonTitle.message: Manage what you’ve hidden on Twitch

showDespiteRules.message: Show this streamer despite the matching categories and keywords

emptyStreamers.message: Nothing hidden yet. Use the moon beside a streamer to snooze them.

emptySearch.message: No hidden streamers match your search.

listNote.message: Also lists category and keyword matches from your open Twitch tabs.

categoriesNote.message: Hidden until you remove them. Streamers you always show stay visible.

keywordsIntro.message: Hides streams whose title or tags contain this word, like drops, 24/7 or a tag.

keywordNoMatches.message: No matches in your open tabs

keywordsNote.message: Matches whole words on stream cards and search results. The sidebar shows no titles, so a sidebar row is hidden only when the same stream’s card on the page matches.

alwaysIntro.message: Always visible, in every category and on every list.

emptyAlways.message: Keep favourites visible: add a channel above, or use the star in a hidden streamer’s menu.

alwaysNote.message: Overrides snoozes, categories and keywords. Removing someone resumes their saved rules.

removeAlwaysHelp.message: Their saved hiding rules apply again

backupHelp.message: Save or restore your rules (opens in a new tab)

peekHelp.message: Show hidden items faded instead of removing them

reviewAria.message: Leave a review for Twitch Snooze (opens in a new tab)

backupIntro.message: Your hidden streamers, categories, keywords and always-shown streamers are stored only in this browser. Save a backup before reinstalling, or to move your rules to another computer.

backupRestoreIntro.message: Choose a .json file saved by Twitch Snooze. You’ll see what’s in it before anything changes.

backupContains.message: This backup has {summary}. Choose how to load it.

backupReplaceWarn.message: Replace removes every current snooze, category, keyword and always-shown streamer, then loads the backup. This can’t be undone.

backupMerged.message: Backup added. This browser now has {summary}.

backupReplaced.message: Rules replaced. This browser now has {summary}.

backupFoot.message: Backups contain channel names, category names, keywords and dates. Expired snoozes are left out. Nothing is uploaded, and open Twitch tabs update right away.

errInvalidRequest.message: Twitch Snooze couldn’t understand this request.

errSave.message: Twitch Snooze couldn’t save this change.

errAlwaysShown.message: Stop always showing this streamer before hiding them.

errRuleGone.message: This category rule no longer exists.

errNoRule.message: Choose a category rule that still exists.

errAllow.message: Choose whether to show this channel.

errKeywordInvalid.message: Enter a word or phrase with letters or numbers.

errNoKeyword.message: Choose a keyword that still exists.

errSnoozeTime.message: The snooze end time is invalid.

errNotSnoozed.message: This channel is no longer snoozed.

errImportMode.message: Choose whether to add to or replace your rules.

errUndoRestore.message: This can no longer be undone.

errUndoNewer.message: A newer change was made or this Undo expired, so it can’t be undone.

errNotFromExtension.message: This request didn’t come from Twitch Snooze.

errRegister.message: Only an open Twitch tab can register.

errLearn.message: Only an open Twitch tab can share page details.

errReload.message: Twitch Snooze was updated. Refresh this Twitch tab to keep using it.

errGeneric.message: Couldn’t update Twitch Snooze. Refresh this Twitch tab and try again.

errEnterChannel.message: Enter a Twitch channel name or link.

errEnterCategory.message: Enter the category name as it appears on Twitch.

errBackupNotOurs.message: This file isn’t a Twitch Snooze backup.

errBackupNewer.message: This backup was made by a newer version of Twitch Snooze. Update the extension first.

errBackupEmpty.message: This backup has no active rules to import.

errBackupJson.message: This file couldn’t be read as a backup.

errBackupLarge.message: This file is too large to be a Twitch Snooze backup.
